deadline.value: Priority I deadline for Fall entry is November 1; Priority II is May 1.

gre_subject.value: Engineering has no GRE Subject test in the Lyle pages.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are required for PhD applicants, unless the program says otherwise.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are required for Ph.D. applicants and optional for master’s applicants

also.quote: Mechanical Engineering Ph.D. applicants who have earned or are currently pursuing a Master of Science degree are not required to submit GRE scores.

fee_waiver.value: Lyle waives the application fee for new graduate applicants who apply by October 31, 2026 for 2027 programs.
fee_waiver.quote: Apply by October 31 to qualify for an application fee waiver for 2027 Lyle graduate programs

supervisor.value: The Lyle pages do not say whether a supervisor's agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: Teaching and research assistantships are limited and highly competitive.
funding.quote: Financial assistance is available to students via teaching and research assistantships. These are limited and highly competitive.

entry_route.value: The Lyle pages do not say whether a master's is needed.

notes: GRE is not required for ME PhD applicants who hold or are pursuing an MS (Lyle FAQ). Overrides are the GRE rule and the October 31, 2026 fee waiver.
